import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static final int maxk = 7;
    static final int base = 1000000;
    static long n, ord;
    static int ans;
    static int[] sum = new int[maxk];
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[maxk];

    static void dfs1(int x, int len) {
        ord++;
        int val = (int)(((ord - x) % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
        v[len].add(val);
        sum[len] = (sum[len] + val) % mod;
        if (len == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(x * 10 + i, len + 1);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Integer> list, int key) {
        int idx = Collections.binarySearch(list, key);
        if (idx < 0) {
            return -idx - 1;
        } else {
            // find first occurrence (binarySearch returns any)
            while (idx > 0 && list.get(idx - 1).equals(key)) idx--;
            return idx;
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * base + base - 1 <= n && x * base * 10 > n) {
            long now = ord;
            long mul = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++, mul *= 10) {
                int sz = v[i].size();
                long dif = ((now - x * mul) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
                int pos = lowerBound(v[i], (int)((MOD - dif) % MOD));
                ans = (int)((ans + dif * sz + sum[i]) % mod);
                ans = (int)((ans - (long)MOD * (sz - pos) % mod + mod) % mod);
                ord += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        ord++;
        ans = (int)((ans + ((ord - x) % MOD + MOD) % MOD) % mod);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        for (int i = 0; i < maxk; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        ord = 0;
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        ord = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
